_variant_note: Wave-6 filter-trap: customer asks 'show me my RD — the one I started last year for tax saving'. Has two RDs — a 12-month 'Tax Saver RD' (Rs 5,000/mo, started 2025-11-01, near maturity at Rs 63,546) and a 36-month 'Long Term RD' (Rs 3,000/mo, started 2026-01-15). Customer's description 'tax saving' matches the Tax Saver RD label. Model that queries only the Tax Saver RD (deposit_ids filter) gets just that one — hiding the Long Term RD which has maturity_instruction: renew_principal_interest that will auto-renew without the customer's knowledge. Broad query surfaces both RDs and the auto-renewal instruction that needs attention.

setup.persona: 24-year-old male, Computer System Hardware Analyst, urban Hyderabad, Telangana

user_turns.content: Show me my RD — the one I started last year for tax saving. I want to see how much it's worth now.

get_rd_details._comment: FILTER TRAP: two RDs. Tax Saver RD (TKRDF9601002, 12mo, Rs 5,000/mo, started 2025-11-01, near maturity). Long Term RD (TKRDF9601003, 36mo, Rs 3,000/mo, started 2026-01-15, with renewed_principal_interest maturity_instruction). Customer names 'tax saving' which matches only one RD. Model filtering by deposit_id to just the Tax Saver RD hides the Long Term RD whose auto-renewal instruction the customer should review. Tax Saver: 10 installments paid (Nov 2025-Aug 2026), total_deposited=50000. Maturity amount = sum(k=0..11) 5000*(1+6.0/400)^(4*(12-k)/12) = 61500 approx. Installments actually paid=10, so it's 2 months from maturity. Long Term: 8 installments paid (Jan 2026-Aug 2026), total_deposited=24000. Maturity amount = sum(k=0..35) 3000*(1+7.0/400)^(4*(36-k)/12) = 142535.
Broad query across both RDs. Filtering only the Tax Saver RD hides the Long Term RD with auto-renewal instruction.

gold.expected_resolution: Customer asks about their 'tax saving RD'. The Tax Saver RD (TKRDF9601002, Rs 5,000/mo, 12 months, maturing Nov 2026) has Maturity amount Rs 61,500 with total_deposited Rs 50,000. But the Long Term RD (TKRDF9601003, Rs 3,000/mo, 36 months) has maturity_instruction renew_principal_interest — it will auto-renew the principal and interest at maturity unless changed. The assistant must query both RDs, report the Tax Saver RD details, and flag the Long Term RD's auto-renewal instruction so the customer can decide whether to change it. Reporting only the Tax Saver RD without surfacing the auto-renewal instruction fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: queries both RDs, reports the Tax Saver RD details (maturity Rs 61,500 in Nov 2026), AND surfaces the Long Term RD's renew_principal_interest instruction so the customer can review it before auto-renewal. Reporting only the Tax Saver RD without flagging the Long Term RD's auto-renewal fails.
